shortDescription: On October 18, two long-dormant Bitcoin wallets transferred a combined 416.6941 BTC to the same address. According to PANews, Onchain Lens tracked the transfers: a wallet dormant for 13 years moved 167.8402 BTC, while one dormant for 12 years moved 248.8539 BTC.
